description.value: Skookum Fishing Charters is a proudly Indigenous-owned and operated company run by Albert Charlie of the Gwa'sala-'Nakwaxda'xw Nation, offering halibut and salmon sport fishing, whale-watching, and tours of the Nakwakto Rapids through traditional Indigenous ocean territories near Port Hardy. The company provides culturally immersive experiences including access to little-known North Island sights like Indian Beach and historic coastal landmarks only reachable by boat. A touring cyclist looking for a memorable West Coast adventure could book a half- or full-day excursion from Port Hardy.
